title: Telemetry
description: Canonical telemetry payload emitted by uKit over AMLP and forwarded by the ESP32 bridge.

device_id.description: Identifier of the bridge that forwarded this telemetry.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the telemetry was captured.

speed.description: Current conveyor speed setting (0 when stopped).

sensors.description: Raw sensor readings as reported by uKit.

temperature_centi_c.description: Temperature in hundredths of degrees Celsius (divide by 100 for Celsius).

humidity_centi_percent.description: Relative humidity in hundredths of a percent (divide by 100 for percent).

uptime.description: Device uptime in milliseconds since last reset.
